description:
Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-liquibase (over an in-memory H2 datasource)
        on top of the bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Liquibase panel light-up: the change-log history
        read from the application's io.quarkus.liquibase.LiquibaseFactory by the QuarkusLiquibaseProvider is
        shaped by the shared engine LiquibaseService, the applied change sets are surfaced on
        GET /bootui/api/liquibase/changesets, and the panel is reported available in the manifest. Kept separate
        from bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO quarkus-liquibase, so the capability
        gate keeps the liquibase panel unavailable) so the liquibase-present and liquibase-absent paths are each
        proven in isolation — the same split used for the Cache-present/absent and SmallRye-Health-present/absent
        coverage.
